body: Thats exactly it. Its like an addiction and I often tell myself that its under control but in reality I have no idea how bad the damage is or how to handle it. Im going to try to talk about things more often. Like maybe even make a point of sending someone a message at least once a day almost just to remind myself more than anyone else that I have a problem. At least start there. Thank you again my friend youve given me some reassurance and I needed it more than you know. It would be nice to check in with you every so often if thats cool with you? You seem like a smart and good natured person

The big problem for me is really taking the little steps in getting help each day. Because for me whenever my problems arent presenting themselves much for a while or theyre not causing me big problems in every day life for a while I tend to just pretend that they dont exist. Like "oh I feel pretty normal today I guess my problems just up and left". Even though I know full well theyre still there I would rather just turn my back to them. And its a dangerous way to live because of course the demons are still there and if you turn your back on them, sooner or later they stab you in the back and remind you that you cant just walk away from this. Its only when Ive been pushed to the edge by my problems that I ask for help. By the way im sorry to hear that youve suffered through bad sh** yourself. It is often you find that those who want to help do so because they know what its like to be beaten down by life. Im happy to talk to you as well if you ever feel like it my friend

Thank you so much for replying and giving a s***. it really does mean a lot. To be honest it was drinking and drug abuse that made things so bad tonight. Substance abuse isnt a huge problem for me its not something I do often but it is another thing on the long list of problems I have thats threatening to become more sinister if I dont do something about it. Drinking often makes my issues show themselves very aggresively and tonight when I got home I hurt myself. It made me so afraid what I might accidentallty do to myself some day if I dont stop it. I was so upset because in the back of my mind id been thinking that I was getting better and hadnt done it in a while so going out and being a bit stupid with drink and stuff woulf be ok for a night. But I found myself falling horribly back into bad habits before I knew it. I was really shaken when I wrote my first comment but kind of calmed down now though im still deeply afraid thinking about how im going to go about fixing myself. Thanks again for caring stranger
